description: This file is a Next.js page component for displaying a travel post. It includes server-side functions for fetching post data and generating metadata for SEO, as well as rendering components to show post details, images, story content, tips, and interactions like liking or favoriting.

methods.name: fetchPost
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a post by ID from the API endpoint, returning the Post object or null if not found.

methods.name: PostDetailsPage
methods.description: Main server-side React component for rendering the post details page. Handles fetching post data, handling not found cases, and rendering the post content including images, story, tips, and action buttons.
